VI.description: Ask whether a project is ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and nothing else. READ-ONLY\3A it takes the reference Application\3AProject\3AActive Project hands out\2C closes it again\2C and reports the error code - it does not save\2C close or touch the project.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. Measured 2026-09-03\3A lvai_open_file answered `No Error` three times in a row for a .lvproj that plainly exists\2C and no project became active - every following call answered Error 1055. What fixed it was giving the LabVIEW WINDOW the foreground\3B Chrome had focus. Diagnosing that cost 270 s of wall clock for 2.9 s inside LabVIEW\2C because nothing in the chain reported the state\2C so lvai_open_file now checks for itself.\0A\0AERROR 1055 IS THE ANSWER\2C NOT A FAULT. It means no project is active\2C which is exactly the question. Code 0 means one is.\0A\0AThe property chain is copied from lvai_close_active_project.vi rather than derived\3A the VI Server catalogue does not list the {LV.Project} class at all\2C so its members were found by probing\2C and reusing a proven spelling avoids naming an uncatalogued class in a file ValidateAIXML has to parse - which is a measured LabVIEW crash site (OMAutoClasses.cpp).
